name: Myke Adams
caption: The Suicidal Superman, who won the ladder match for a Bunkhouse Brawl place on 27 July 2009 and was the newly crowned Heavyweight champion by 10 August.

tenures.source: Ranked first for the heavyweight title on 22 July 2009 (To Be Determined); won the ladder match against Grim on 27 July; newly crowned Heavyweight champion by 10 August, beating the other finalist Samuel Hessingstock in a non-title main event.

name: Samuel Hessingstock
caption: The other finalist of the Bunkhouse Brawl, ranked second to Myke Adams for the heavyweight title on 12 August 2009.

tenures.source: Lost the non-title main event to Myke Adams on 10 August 2009 as the other Brawl finalist; ranked second on 12 August; announced for 17 August in a tag match against Myke Adams and Alexander Steele.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Scarlett Willis
caption: A former SCCW tag champion in the fed's own words, who beat Emanuel Jackson on 27 July 2009 and won a triple threat on 10 August that the fed said could put her in line for the All Barrie or Barbaric title.

tenures.source: Ranked tenth for the heavyweight title on 22 July 2009, fifth for the All Barrie title on 28 July and fifth for the heavyweight title on 12 August; beat Emanuel Jackson on 27 July and Jen Blackheart and Sharlene Berger on 10 August; announced to team with Georgie Nickles on 17 August.

name: Jay Jerzey
caption: The Barbaric champion by 10 August 2009 after what the fed called the most bloody and brutal match in its history; announced to defend against Rex Masters on 17 August.

tenures.source: Ranked third for the heavyweight title on 22 July 2009; the Barbaric champion by 10 August, after a match with Patrick McCarthy; announced to defend against Rex Masters on 17 August.

name: Patrick McCarthy
caption: Beat Greg Venom on 27 July 2009 and fought Jay Jerzey for the Barbaric title; the fed's news says he had not been seen at the studios since.

tenures.source: Ranked fourth for the heavyweight title on 22 July 2009; beat Greg Venom on 27 July; the 12 August news says he had not shown up at the studios or the SCCW office since his match with Jay Jerzey for the Barbaric title.

name: Chris Champion
caption: Ranked fifth for the heavyweight title on 22 July 2009.

tenures.source: Ranked fifth for the heavyweight title in the rankings of 22 July 2009.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: The Machine
caption: Ranked sixth for the heavyweight title on 22 July 2009, and called out by Emanuel Jackson in the fed's 27 July preview.

tenures.source: Ranked sixth for the heavyweight title on 22 July 2009; named by Emanuel Jackson as a target in the 27 July preview.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Riflewilly
caption: The All Barrie champion until he lost to Sydney LaRoux on 27 July 2009; Paul Cain's partner until Cain turned on him after the 10 August loss.

tenures.source: Listed as All Barrie champion on 22 July 2009; lost the title to Sydney LaRoux on 27 July; teamed with Paul Cain on 10 August, after which the fed says the team was no more.

name: Sydney LaRoux
caption: Took the All Barrie Championship from Riflewilly on 27 July 2009 and was still champion on 12 August.

tenures.source: Won the All Barrie Championship from Riflewilly on 27 July 2009; ranked first for it on 28 July; teamed with War Machine on 10 August as the All Barrie champion.

name: Sharlene Berger
caption: Already in the Bunkhouse Brawl by 27 July 2009; lost to Kirsta Lewis that night and ranked fourth for the All Barrie title the next day.

tenures.source: Called "already in the BRAWL" on 27 July 2009; lost to Kirsta Lewis; ranked fourth for the All Barrie title on 28 July; lost the 10 August triple threat to Scarlett Willis.

name: Emanuel Jackson
caption: Lost to Scarlett Willis on 27 July 2009 after calling out The Machine; ranked sixth for the All Barrie title on 28 July.

tenures.source: Lost to Scarlett Willis on 27 July 2009; ranked sixth for the All Barrie title on 28 July.

name: Blade
caption: A former Roughkut Wrestling champion still looking to make his mark in Simcoe County; ranked seventh for the All Barrie title on 28 July 2009.

tenures.source: Ranked seventh for the All Barrie title on 28 July 2009; lost the 10 August triple threat to Greg Venom; announced against "Vamp" for 17 August.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Jen Blackheart
caption: Ranked ninth for the All Barrie title on 28 July 2009; lost the 10 August triple threat to Scarlett Willis.

tenures.source: Ranked ninth for the All Barrie title on 28 July 2009; lost the 10 August triple threat to Scarlett Willis.

name: Alexander Steele
caption: Drew with Justin Brooks on 27 July 2009 to enter the Brawl and lost to Doctor Ian on 10 August; the fed calls him Jace Steele's son.

tenures.source: Drew with Justin Brooks on 27 July 2009 (both made the Brawl); ranked tenth for the All Barrie title on 28 July; lost to Dr. Ian on 10 August; announced to team with Myke Adams on 17 August.

name: Justin Brooks
caption: Drew with Alexander Steele on 27 July 2009 to enter the Brawl, and lost a triple threat on 10 August; announced to team with Paul Cain on 17 August.

tenures.source: Drew with Alexander Steele on 27 July 2009; lost the 10 August triple threat to Greg Venom; the 12 August news announces him as Paul Cain's partner for 17 August without saying why.

name: Grim
caption: Lost the ladder match to Myke Adams on 27 July 2009, a week after an unresolved first fight.

tenures.source: Fought Myke Adams to no result the week before 27 July 2009 and lost their ladder match for a Brawl place on the 27th.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Rex Masters
caption: Announced as the Barbaric challenger to Jay Jerzey for 17 August 2009, after a showing in the Bunkhouse Brawl match.

tenures.source: The 12 August 2009 news announces him as the Barbaric challenger for 17 August, after "an alright showing in the BRAWL match itself".

name: Darrel Leon
caption: Announced as "Vamp", new to SCCW, for the opening match against Blade on 17 August 2009.

tenures.source: The 12 August 2009 news announces him as "Vamp", new to SCCW and its rings, to open the 17 August card against Blade.
